{{Quote|Second Level Security, prepare your defenses, he's coming your way.|[[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] referring to [[Galen Marek]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" />}}
'''Second Level Security''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] security unit of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Riot stormtrooper/Legends|riot stormtroopers]] that were stationed in a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] in [[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" /> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="TFUIIComic" /> a [[Subject 1138|clone]] of [[Galen Marek]] tore his way though the casino, easily defeating the Imperial troops in his way, including Second Level Security troops.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" />
